items.title: Camera closer: average of D2R, D4 and PoE2
body: The hero is now 11.6% of the screen height, the average of D2R, Diablo IV and PoE2 (was 7.8%).
Known: the ground texture looks soft this close and she looks pale (lantern too strong). World fixes both in the light pass.

items.title: Fireball v6: new impact
body: Game camera, full frame, 1x, real time. Flight same as before.
Impact is now one fire mass that blooms and breaks up (was a white star and popcorn puffs).
Leaves a flat glowing ember patch on the ground, like D2R.
Fire kills no longer spray blood and bone: a few embers and a short scorch on the body.

media.caption: Impact frame by frame, D2R on the right
Ground ember patch, D2R on the right

items.picked: Closer in style, quality not there (owner, terminal)

items.title: Hero run: pick A, B or C (plus new hair)
items.ask: Which run is closest to what you want?
body: Top row: D2R sorceress running (study only). Below: three real recorded runs on our hero, untouched.

A: current Mixamo run (the one you called bad). B: woman mocap run, athletic, big strides. C: calm upright jog, small arms, closest to D2R; head looks a bit down in the source, and the hero would move slower (about 2 m/s vs 3).
New body fem9: long tapered hair with face locks, temple tufts gone. Hair sways later (after your pick).

media.caption: Runs A, B, C under D2R
fem9 running, game camera, 1x full frame

items.title: Hero run: A, D or B
body: All untouched Mixamo runs, staff grip as in the game, arms checked joint by joint, no hand edits.
D: most upright, calmest arms, least lean (reviewer pick). B: most neutral chest, bigger arm swing. A: current.
First video: zoomed beside D2R (study). Then each at game camera 1x full frame.

items.title: Hero chest fix (until your new model)
items.ask: Put this chest fix in the game for now?
body: Installed model, only the chest changed; arms, hair and skeleton untouched.
Reads female from the side and 3/4 at 1x; from the front it is faint under the busy robe.

items.title: New lighting (in the game now)
items.ask: Does the new light look right?
body: Left: before. Right: now. Game camera, full frame, 1x, three different rooms.
Fixed: the hero is no longer blown pale-yellow; she has her own soft light now.
The lantern pool is softer and the whole frame got darker. You said not overly dark: tell me if it went too far.

items.title: Prop test: A vs StableGen (B) vs paint-over (C)
items.ask: OK with the route: C shapes + A surfaces, StableGen dropped?
body: Same 3 props (boulder, barrel, skull pole) in room 1, game camera 1x; second picture zoomed 2x.
A (our way): best surfaces. B (StableGen): rejected: faceted origami boulder with black holes, toy-orange barrel.
C (cut from a painted room shot, then 3D): most natural boulder shape, but blotchy camo patches and a bright red rag.
Route: C for shapes, A for surfaces. All props still read too grey; World fixes materials per prop type next.

media.caption: Each prop, A / B / C rows, 2x zoom

items.title: Run D in the game

body: Run D installed, untouched, at the new 3 m/s; feet matched to speed. 1x full frame, 30 fps, real time.
Second video: all 16 directions.

items.title: Fireball, rebuilt from the reference study
body: Game camera, full frame, 1x, real time.
Flight: one flame shape, gold streaks with dark red between, small white core, changes every frame.
Hit: short bright flash, then uneven flame licks that fade out in about a third of a second.
Second picture: every frame of one hit at 1x, so you can see it frame by frame.

media.caption: Flight frame by frame beside D2R (1x and 4x)

items.picked: Still off: does not match our graphics; make a GPT concept from our screenshots first

items.title: Fireball: 3 painted targets in our look
body: GPT painted these from our own game screenshots. Nothing is built in 3D yet; the one you pick becomes the target.
Each sheet: top = flight (6 frames), middle = hit (8 frames to gone), bottom = each layer on its own row (core, body, tail, embers, flash, hit flames, ground mark).

A: compact ember, best fire (GPT changed our hero and floor; ignore those). B: sits in our scene best, but gold threads, a star-shaped flash and tall flames on the monster. C: darkest, hollow head, best scorch mark.
You can also pick a mix, e.g. A's fire with C's scorch: write it in the note.

media.caption: A | B | C side by side
